top_categories.workout_context: 131ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Waucheesi Bike Race, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Waucheesi Bike Race's Cherokee National Forest, Cherohala Skyway country forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 88 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Waucheesi Bike Race. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Waucheesi Bike Race's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
11,500ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
At mile 60 of 88, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Waucheesi Bike Race, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
11,500ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Low-cadence force work for 11,500ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 88 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on appalachian gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Waucheesi Bike Race’s 88 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Waucheesi Bike Race requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on appalachian gravel to build confidence. Expect: cherokee national forest, cherohala skyway country, appalachian forest-road climbs.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 88 miles of appalachian gravel in Tellico Plains, Tennessee.
